description: Far-clip x camera matrix (2026-10-02, docs/FARCLIP-CAMERA-CRASH.md): t01 direct boot, F1, F6 (hood camera, per-frame 0x407680) held 3 s, F1 back, B (binoculars, 0x4071a0) 3 s, B off, then idle to 45 s. Run with --exe i76.exe | i76_pristine_fix.exe and --env I76_FAR_CLIP=<m> (the proxy's in-memory far clip + pools x16); the game surviving both views is the check. camera-hood.json / camera-binoc.json are the single-view repros.
